query: Can I travel if my passport is valid for less than 6 months?
reference_answer: Generally, a passport is only acceptable for travel if it has a validity period of at least 6 months.

answer: If your passport is valid for less than 6 months, you can still travel but must renew it before your trip. Your current passport will be invalidated upon issuing a new one. Ensure your new passport is valid for at least 6 months. [Document 1]
